# Inherited workflows — quarantine

These files are archived outside `.github/workflows/`, so GitHub Actions will not recognize them as active workflows on a branch containing this change. They retain the original bytes and upstream attribution for review and rollback. Do not move them back without explicit review.

Archived: automatic tagging, PyPI publication, desktop releases, Claude issue/review automation, repository clone tracking, issue assignment and Pages deployment. None is needed for the personal local-first MVP.

The six retained test workflows are **not approved to run yet**. Keep repository Actions disabled until action revisions, permissions, dependency installation and PR trust boundaries are reviewed. No publishing, external AI or credential-bearing automation is authorized. See `docs/jarvis-assistant/SUPPLY_CHAIN_REVIEW.md`.

This branch is not merged into main. Repository settings are separate and must remain disabled during Foundation.
